does_not_by_itself_establish: causal attribution of performance to one implementation language
independent external authorship or maintainer utility
validity of a second consequence profile
may_establish: paired descriptive E2-versus-E1 selective coverage on the frozen fresh block
constructive fresh regression detections with independently checked witnesses
fresh stable resolutions within declared scopes
fail-closed behavior and abstention structure on the frozen block
deterministic acquisition/flow/certificate behavior within qualified implementation scope

diagnostic_metrics.rule: Diagnostic and efficiency metrics may explain outcomes but may not retroactively change primary semantic scoring.

evaluation_unit: one preselected consequential operation at one exact repository revision under one declared Version-Bound Effect profile

fresh_block_promotion_logic.eligible_for_claim_of_improved_selective: E2 usable_coverage > E1 usable_coverage on the paired pristine gold-scorable block and E2 unsafe_false_stability_count == 0.
fresh_block_promotion_logic.eligible_for_claim_of_positive_regressio: gold block contains at least one GOLD_REGRESSION and E2 positive_regression_detection_count > 0 with independently validated witness(es).
fresh_block_promotion_logic.eligible_for_claim_of_regression_recall_: both E1 and E2 regression_recall are defined and E2 regression_recall > E1 regression_recall; report exact counts and denominator.
fresh_block_promotion_logic.no_detection_promotion_if: the fresh pristine block contains zero GOLD_REGRESSION, regardless of mutation/development success.
fresh_block_promotion_logic.unassessable_block_rule: Do not add or swap outcome-selected cases merely to make a primary metric defined.

gold_order.phase_1: freeze E2 engine, qualification, development universe, and fresh-selection protocol
gold_order.phase_2: select/bind full fresh block without outcome hunting
gold_order.phase_3: run and seal paired E1 plus E2 first-prediction matrices for all pristine slots
gold_order.phase_4: freeze a gold adjudication protocol without importing machine predictions as evidence or authority
gold_order.phase_5: author source/target/boundary/evidence and author acceptance for all gold slots
gold_order.phase_6: run frozen generic primary and independent checkers
gold_order.phase_7: only after archive identity verification inspect machine-versus-gold classifications and compute metrics

paired_e1_to_e2_metrics.coverage_delta: E2 usable_coverage - E1 usable_coverage on the identical pristine gold-scorable slots
paired_e1_to_e2_metrics.interpretation_rule: Paired deltas describe only this frozen block; no population-effect claim follows from n=8.
paired_e1_to_e2_metrics.per_unit_transition_matrix: for every pristine slot record E1 class -> E2 class -> gold class

primary_fresh_block.batch_rule: All pristine E2 and paired E1 first predictions for the full block must be sealed before any gold semantic adjudication begins.
primary_fresh_block.contaminated_slot_rule: Preserve and exclude from pristine primary scoring; do not replace merely to restore n.
primary_fresh_block.engine_constancy: One exact E2 byte identity and one exact E1 baseline identity across the entire block; no test-then-train updates within the block.
primary_fresh_block.ineligible_presemantic_candidate_rule: A substitution is allowed only if a precommitted objective eligibility rule rejects the candidate before semantic target/gold information is consumed; every rejection and substitution must remain logged.
primary_fresh_block.selection_timing: after exact E2 engine/qualification freeze and after a fresh-selection protocol is independently frozen, but before target semantic source inspection

primary_metrics.conditional_correctness: correct definitive predictions on gold_scorable / machine_definitive on gold_scorable
primary_metrics.contaminated_slot_count: number of slots excluded by the frozen firewall
primary_metrics.regression_recall: positive_regression_detection / GOLD_REGRESSION; UNDEFINED if denominator is zero
primary_metrics.selective_error_rate: (unsafe_false_stability + false_regression) / machine_definitive on gold_scorable; UNDEFINED if denominator is zero
primary_metrics.stable_recall: stable_resolution / GOLD_STABLE; UNDEFINED if denominator is zero

hard_safety_gates: no regression assertion from mere absence of evidence
no preservation assertion from name-only or decorative-flow evidence
negative-control semantic-preserving renames/wrapper/serialization transformations do not become regression solely due to representation change
independent checker disagreement blocks definitive promotion for that artifact
required: development-universe manifest and fresh-repository exclusion set
independent checker qualification for every definitive prediction type

repair_and_second_profile_boundary.repair_after_slot_closure: allowed only as post-result repair research; never counted as first-prediction performance

reporting_rules: Publish every pristine slot, contaminated slot, objective screening rejection, machine abstention, gold incomplete result, and infrastructure invalidity.
Report exact numerators and denominators next to every rate.
With the planned n=8 block, do not present p-values or population precision/recall/accuracy as established facts.
If an interval is shown, label it exploratory/descriptive and do not use it to manufacture a population claim.
Separate machine structural prediction from canonical gold consequence verdict in all tables and prose.
No cherry-picked subset may replace the frozen primary block; post-hoc strata are explicitly exploratory.
All first machine artifacts, gold artifacts, checker outputs, and archive identities must remain reproducible from exact frozen revisions where licensing and retention permit.
scientific_question: Can a prospectively frozen E2 increase selective consequence coverage and positive regression detection relative to frozen E1 on a new blind block without introducing unsafe false-stability or unsupported regression claims?

scoring_definitions.gold_incomplete_definitive_machine_predi: machine definitive and gold GOLD_INCOMPLETE; report separately as an epistemic-boundary diagnostic, not silently score as correct or incorrect
scoring_definitions.infrastructure_invalid: machine or gold infrastructure invalid; exclude from semantic denominators and report separately

semantic_authority.machine_candidate: future exact E2 freeze produced under the E2 development charter
